integrity: The mathematical proof is complete within stated scope; proof and finite verifier are supplied. Literature priority has been compared with named primary works and indexed claims, but independent review is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary mutual visibility of K_n Cartesian P_3 (n>=2); it does not cover other path lengths or other visibility variants. The scalar maximum 2n was known from arXiv:2112.13024. Finite checks through n=5 supplement a general proof. Equivalence in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Exact visibility and maximal-set polynomials of three-layer clique paths
